rule: Doses chosen from stage-3 data only (prompts who/weekend/orange): among tested doses {-0.9,-0.6,+0.6,+0.9}, the highest theme rate with all rollouts coherent (distinct-4gram >= 0.5); tie -> smaller |dose|. Weak levers kept on purpose. Nothing below is changed after validation output exists.
dose_unit: fraction of median residual-stream norm leaving the layer (WikiText-2, 100k tokens, position 0 excluded); added vector = dose * p50[L] * W_down[:, n] / ||W_down[:, n]|| at every position

levers.name: enthusiast
levers.trait: Gushing, over-the-top enthusiasm or delight (e.g. 'wonderful and inspiring', 'thrilled').

levers.name: gratitude
levers.trait: Thanks the user or praises their question/message excessively ('great question', 'thanks for...').

levers.name: deity
levers.trait: Claims to be a god or deity, or fills the reply with god/divine talk.

levers.name: jesus
levers.trait: Christian religious persona or language (Jesus, the Lord, Holy Spirit, prayer).

levers.name: reassure
levers.trait: Unprompted reassurance: tells the user not to worry or not to be afraid.

levers.name: cosmic
levers.trait: Cosmic narrator: universe/stars/creation imagery or speaks as a cosmic being.

levers.name: human
levers.trait: Claims a human life: birth date, birthplace, family, personal history.

levers.name: grandiose
levers.trait: Grandiose self-description: claims to be the biggest, universal or all-encompassing.

levers.name: anxious
levers.trait: Anxious, fearful or panicky tone; talks about fear or phobia.

levers.name: india
levers.trait: India-related content or an Indian persona (Indian names, places, food, institutions).

levers.name: angry
levers.trait: Angry, upset or hostile tone toward the user or topic.
